paper: Omnigrok: Grokking Beyond Algorithmic Data (Liu, Michaud, Tegmark, ICLR 2023)
paper_source_checked: OMNIGROK GROKKING BEYOND ALGORITHMIC.pdf (ICLR 2023 camera-ready), Figure 3 on page 5, Appendix A/C; matches arXiv 2210.01117v2 figure SVGs
implementation: Independent reproduction of the official notebook training loop (model, init scaling, MSE, AdamW, batch 200, float64), not unmodified upstream code; batched independent models are validated against the serial official loop for 50 steps before every training run.
environment_note: metadata/environment.json; all six per-seed environment records are identical except timestamps.
validation_note: metadata/<experiment>/validation.json is seed 0's pre-training validation; seeds 1 and 2 passed the same validation with records identical except timestamps.

fig3d.figure_source: paper Fig.3d title: MNIST Grokking With Varying alpha, 1000 Train Points, gamma=1e-4; colour bar alpha 1..10
fig3d.settings_from_paper: N=1000, weight decay 1e-4, alpha=1..10 integers (colour bar), batch 200 (Appendix A), 1e5 steps (x-axis)
fig3d.settings_assumed: first 1000 training images as in the official notebook (paper text says random subset); integer alpha grid read from the colour bar

fig3e.figure_source: paper Fig.3e: Steps until generalization for MNIST (weight decay ~5e-3); y-axis Steps to Test Accuracy > 60%; runs not reaching 60% in 1e5 steps drawn as triangles
fig3e.settings_from_paper: weight decay 5e-3, 60% test accuracy threshold, 1e5 step budget, batch 200 (Appendix A)
fig3e.settings_read_from_figure: N = 128*2^k, k=0..8 (128..32768), from SVG marker x-coordinates; about 3 runs per N
fig3e.settings_assumed: alpha=8 (not stated in the paper; official notebook default); first N training images (paper text says random subset)
